title: fix(build): declare @types/react for the React libraries whose typings import it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x8Be2AAcUBhodBsvnWLd3Xs)_
Fixes #37015

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:Mac 上的开发者(包括你)从干净检出跑控制台构建,不再停在国际化包的类型错误上;用户无感。
- 为什么做:解决你在 Mac 上验收控制台构建时被卡住的问题,那张验收卡要等这个修好才能继续。
- 出错会怎样:只影响依赖安装与类型检查,不改任何运行时代码;出问题时整笔撤回即可恢复原状。
- 要你做什么:CI 里有一个锁文件样例测试会因为本改动变红,需要席位批准扩一个测试文件的修改范围后再补;之后请在 Mac 上重跑一次验收。

## What changes

- **Root cause (measured on Linux, pnpm 10.31.0 at a73edb3c):** 31 packages in the lockfile ship `.d.ts` files that import `react` but declare no `@types/react` (React 19 ships no types). From their pnpm store directories those imports resolved only through pnpm's hidden hoist (`node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules`). With the hoist off, TypeScript reports nothing for the library (skipLibCheck) and degrades every React type in it to `any`/`{}`: `useContext(I18nContext)` became `{}` (the maintainer's TS2339 at `packNamespace.ts`), `LucideProps` lost `className`, the `input-otp` context became `unknown`, `cmdk` callbacks became implicit `any`.
- **Fix:** `pnpm-workspace.yaml` gains a `packageExtensions` block declaring `@types/react` (plus `@types/react-dom` for `react-router` and `next`) as a peer of each of the 31 packages. pnpm then links the workspace's own `@types/react` into each package's store directory, so the types resolve the same way under any hoist setting. `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the regenerated consequence: `packageExtensionsChecksum` plus peer suffixes on snapshot keys; no version moves, still exactly one `@types/react@19.3.0` and one `@types/react-dom@19.3.0`.
- **Why this fix and not the other two candidates:**
  - A typed local read in `packNamespace.ts` fixes one line out of a family of 31 packages. The console build would stop at the next one (`@object-ui/components`, measured below).
  - `public-hoist-pattern` for `@types/*` is still hoisting. It works only while the package's real path sits under the project root, so it fails under a global virtual store. It also makes `@types/react` visible to every workspace package that does not declare it.
  - A peer, not a dependency: a peer resolves to the version the importer already has. A dependency would resolve on its own and could pull a second `@types/react`, which would split React's types.
- **Guard:** `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/react-typings-own-resolution-37015.test.ts` asks TypeScript's own module resolver where `react` resolves from the typings of each third-party dependency of `@object-ui/i18n`. It uses a host that cannot see above the `node_modules` directory holding that library, so it judges the no-hoist layout whatever the running install hoisted. A pin asserts that `react-i18next` is among the packages checked.

## Tests

<details><summary>Before / after on the hoist-disabled install (fail → pass)</summary>

Install: `pnpm install --config.hoist=false --ignore-scripts` (no `node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules`).

- Before (a73edb3c): `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/i18n` → exit 2, `src/namespaces/packNamespace.ts(302,48): error TS2339: Property 'i18n' does not exist on type '{}'.`
- Before: the console build with `--continue` (`turbo run build:dist --filter=@objectstack/console`) → exit 2. 26 tasks failed. The root errors were i18n (above) and `@object-ui/components`: TS2339 `className` on `LucideProps`, TS18046 on the `input-otp` context, TS7006 on a `cmdk` callback. The rest cascaded from those two packages having no declarations.
- Before: `turbo run type-check` over the 25 ui packages that consume a family library → exit 2, 48 tasks failed.
- After (with the fix, same install flags): the console build → exit 0, `Tasks: 77 successful, 77 total`. The type-check sweep → exit 0, `Tasks: 100 successful, 100 total`. No ui type-check task was replayed from cache.
- Census (a scratch script that walks the live store dirs): before, 31 of 88 store packages whose typings import `react` had no `@types/react` sibling. After, 0 of 88.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: drop only react-i18next's packageExtensions line</summary>

Done with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 → 0, blob b5191a6c → 96febcb1. Restored to HEAD blob b5191a6c, `git diff HEAD` empty, lockfile restored with `git checkout HEAD --`.

- Hoist-disabled install: the guard test fails (1 failed | 1 passed), and `@object-ui/i18n` build (forced) is back to exit 2 with the same TS2339.
- Hoisting install (clean `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, hidden hoist present): the i18n build is GREEN (exit 0), and the guard test is RED (1 failed | 1 passed). A build or type check cannot see this regression on CI's hoisting install. The test can.
</details>

<details><summary>Normal hoisting install, after the fix</summary>

- Clean `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` → exit 0, which also shows the lockfile matches `packageExtensions`.
- The guard test: 2/2 passed. `@object-ui/i18n` build `--force`: 5/5.
- `turbo run build:dist --filter=@objectstack/console --force` (what `pnpm console:build` runs) → exit 0, `Tasks: 77 successful, 77 total`, `Cached: 0 cached, 77 total`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` passed. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new test.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/` → `Test Files 111 passed (111)`, `Tests 2028 passed | 13 skipped`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Known red: `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-lockfile-integrity.test.ts`** (sample (b)). It pins the snapshot key spelling `'@ai-sdk/react@4.0.121(react@19.3.0)(zod@4.6.7)'`. This change moves that key, legitimately, to one that also carries `(@types/react@19.3.0)`. The test's own message reads "snapshot key moved". The fix is a one-string update to that sample, but that file is outside this dispatch's file surface, so it is not edited here. The seat will decide whether to extend the surface.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` printed PREREQUISITE NOT MET locally because this worktree has no full `pnpm build`. Not measured here; CI runs it.
- Five ui packages declare no `@types/react` of their own (`layout`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-view`). They find it by walking up to `ui/node_modules`. Noted only; their builds pass both ways.
- Reading `useContext(` across `ui/packages` found two third-party contexts read directly: `I18nContext` in `packNamespace.ts`, and the `input-otp` context in `components/src/ui/input-otp.tsx`. Both are covered by this fix.
- `useTranslation` and `I18nextProvider` in `provider.tsx` degraded without any error before the fix: line 302 was the only i18n error. Inferred from that one error; not measured separately.
- Long-term guard for the whole family: a check that fails when a lockfile package's typings import `react` without a declared or extended `@types/react`, or a CI leg that installs with `hoist=false`. It needs `scripts/` plus a governed workflow, so it is not added here.

## Verification

First files to read, highest risk first:
1. `pnpm-workspace.yaml`: the `packageExtensions` block and its comment.
2. `pnpm-lock.yaml`: only peer suffixes and `packageExtensionsChecksum` should change.
3. `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/react-typings-own-resolution-37015.test.ts`: the confined resolver host.

Two-minute check: from a clean checkout, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --config.hoist=false --ignore-scripts && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/i18n`. Expect `Tasks: 5 successful, 5 total`. On origin/main the same command fails with the TS2339 above.

Gates (local subset, head 86e2b458): 41 of the 42 `dispatch-gates --commands` families exited 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` printed PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3). `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` gave 171 files passed and 1 failed: the lockfile-integrity sample above.
